related.title: IonQ 個別定址：Gaussian 光束串擾
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付固定窗與等角度兩種實驗設計，並標出不能直接比較的欄位。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver fixed-window and equal-angle experiment plans, marking incomparable fields. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IonQ 個別定址：Gaussian 光束串擾』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付光斑截面、強度／場幅區分及失焦診斷。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ individual addressing: Gaussian-beam crosstalk', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver beam sections, intensity/field-amplitude distinctions and defocus diagnosis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 使用教學參考Δ0=100 GHz、Γ0=40 s⁻¹，Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²；固定觀察窗200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式40*(100/100)**2*200e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對Γsc單位s⁻¹乘秒得無量綱；若要同旋轉角，另延長門時間並重新積分散射。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：Gaussian強度比I(d)/I0=exp(−2d²/w²)，w是1/e²強度半徑；Rabi頻率比為其平方根。 使用教學離子間距d=4 μm、光束w=2 μm；只計單束幾何尾端。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-2*4**2/2**2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查d=0比值1；以ln(I/I0)對d²斜率−2/w²重估腰寬。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: At fixed single-photon drive, scattering proxy Γsc∝1/Δ²; Raman coupling also changes with detuning, so scattering is not the only metric. Use Teaching reference Δ0=100 GHz, Γ0=40 s⁻¹ and Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²; observation window is fixed at200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 40*(100/100)**2*200e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check s⁻¹ times seconds is dimensionless; equal-angle operation requires a separate duration adjustment and new scattering integral.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Gaussian intensity ratio I(d)/I0=exp(−2d²/w²), where w is1/e² intensity radius; Rabi-frequency ratio is its square root. Use Teaching ion spacing d=4 μm and beam w=2 μm; consider only the geometric tail of one beam. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-2*4**2/2**2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check ratio1 at d=0; recover waist from slope−2/w² of ln(I/I0) versus d².
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 使用教學參考Δ0=100 GHz、Γ0=40 s⁻¹，Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²；固定觀察窗200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式40*(100/100)**2*200e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對Γsc單位s⁻¹乘秒得無量綱；若要同旋轉角，另延長門時間並重新積分散射。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以作用能量等於驅動能量定義教學半徑rb=(C6/(ℏΩ))^(1/6)；fR=Ω/(2π)，所以rb=r0[(V0/h)/fR]^(1/6)，括號內為無量綱頻率比。 使用合成V0/h=64 MHz於r0=3 μm、fR=1 MHz；沒有宣稱此半徑內完全零誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式3*(64/1)**(1/6)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：將rb代回64(3/rb)⁶應還原1或2 MHz；不可在一邊用Ω、另一邊用Hz。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: At fixed single-photon drive, scattering proxy Γsc∝1/Δ²; Raman coupling also changes with detuning, so scattering is not the only metric. Use Teaching reference Δ0=100 GHz, Γ0=40 s⁻¹ and Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²; observation window is fixed at200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 40*(100/100)**2*200e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check s⁻¹ times seconds is dimensionless; equal-angle operation requires a separate duration adjustment and new scattering integral.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Define teaching radius rb=(C6/(ℏΩ))^(1/6) by equal interaction and drive energies. With fR=Ω/(2π), rb=r0[(V0/h)/fR]^(1/6), using a dimensionless frequency ratio. Use Synthetic V0/h=64 MHz at r0=3 μm and fR=1 MHz; no claim of zero error inside this radius. Evaluate nominal expression 3*(64/1)**(1/6) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute rb into64(3/rb)⁶ to recover1 or2 MHz; never mix Ω on one side with Hz on the other.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
